Blasted Chicken
By: n
Published: Sunday, February 13, 2011 - 3:05pm

Ingredients




1 whole chicken. 
salt
pepper
garlic

Preparation

1 Clean off chicken remove all innards 2 Salt and pepper the bird 3 Put the garlic in the cavity and under the skin. 4 Per heat over to 450 5 Put bird in  a roasting pan. uncovered 6 Blast for about 40 minutes or until done 7 And thats all.
